entities.name: Query DNA polymerase
observations: 768 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 87.7 kDa and theoretical pI 8.12.
Sequence contains DNA_pol_B_exo1 (PF03104) at residues 166–398 and DNA_pol_B (PF00136) at residues 413–512 and 625–761.
Best reviewed homologs are ascovirus DNA polymerases, including Q4U3V0 at 100% identity and A4KX57/Q779J8 at about 44% identity with near-complete query coverage.
Functional assignment is supported primarily by homology and Pfam domain architecture; direct experimental evidence for this exact sequence is unavailable.

The sequence is predicted to catalyze template-directed DNA synthesis using 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphates, with pyrophosphate release; associated EC number is 2.7.7.7 and Rhea is RHEA:22508.

entities.name: Q4U3V0
observations: Reviewed Trichoplusia ni ascovirus 2c DNA polymerase homolog; EC 2.7.7.7 and RHEA:22508.
Annotated to DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity, DNA binding, nucleotide binding, and viral DNA genome replication.

entities.name: A4KX57
observations: Reviewed Heliothis virescens ascovirus 3e DNA polymerase homolog; 43.6% identity and 99.1% query coverage to the query.
Annotated with EC 2.7.7.7 and RHEA:22508 for viral genome replication.

entities.name: Q779J8
observations: Reviewed Spodoptera frugiperda ascovirus 1a DNA polymerase homolog; 44.4% identity and 98.8% query coverage to the query.
Annotated with EC 2.7.7.7 and RHEA:22508 for viral genome replication.

observations: Mapped in the protein analysis to RHEA:17339, RHEA:17340, and RHEA:22508; EC classification is 2.7.7.7.
